title: Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale
description: 14 items over the past week, each with its own four response options scored 0–3; odd items form the anxiety scale, even items the depression scale.

holder.name: GL Assessment (distributed by Mapi Research Trust)

citation.text: Zigmond AS, Snaith RP (1983). The Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale. Acta Psychiatrica Scandinavica 67(6):361–370.

scoring.text: Two sums of seven items (0–21 each): anxiety = items 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13; depression = items 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14. 0–7 normal, 8–10 borderline, 11–21 abnormal. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.

note: Enter each item's four options in score order (0 first), whatever order the printed form uses.
